items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: there was a guy named Maurice Palmer and we had a little band

ctx.x: I was with Jimmy Lucky in Grand Rapids and he was a trumpet player out of Chicago and he came up there and there was a guy named Maurice Palmer and we had a little band. And Bernie Peacock, who was a friend of mine, a very famous alto player, later on. And a little drummer was around there and he was playin' drums and his name was Wilbur Ware. Yeah, that's where I met him. He was playin' drums, just a kid. And I saw him in New York several times and I says, "You know I remember you," and so we laughed about that.…
[D.F.: Who were some of the first singers that you listened to and were influenced by?]
